title: Action on one ideal summand equals tensor multiplication
statement: Let $j:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes, $L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module and $J=\ker j$ with $J^2=0$ [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-sc-invertible-module, def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf, def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]. Let $n\ge0$, let $T$ be a TensorGradedPresentation with ideal module $I$, injections $k_d:K_d\to I$, where $K_d=\ker(\eta_{L^d})$, and section inclusions $c_d$ [lem-sc-square-zero-tensor-graded-presentation, lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let $D$ equal canonicalTensorBoundaryComparisons for $j,L,J^2=0,n$ [lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit]. Let $f:\mathcal O_Z\to (j^*L)^n$ and $s=\operatorname{tensorGradedSection}(T,D,0,\operatorname{tensorPowSection}(f,1))$ [lem-sc-square-zero-tensor-graded-product-projection]. Suppose $\sigma_U:C(U)\to\operatorname{End}_{\mathcal O_X(U)}(I(U))$ are ring maps satisfying $i(\sigma_U(p(b))y)=b i(y)$ and commuting with all restrictions. Let $\mu:C(X)\to\operatorname{End}(I)$ be a ring map with $(\mu(g))_U(y)=\sigma_U(g|_U)y$ [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-ringed-space-algebra-module]. For each $e\ge0$ put $F=j^*(J\otimes L^n)$, $N=(j^*L)^n$, $A_r=F\otimes N^r$. Define $S_r:j_*A_r\simeq K_{n(r+1)}$ to be the pushed-forward inverse boundaryCoefficientDegreeIso followed by the inverse adjunction unit on $J\otimes L^{n(r+1)}$ and boundaryIdealKernelIso [lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit]. Then $k_{n(e+1)}\gg\mu(s)=S_e^{-1}\gg j_*(\operatorname{mulTensorPowSection}(f,F,e,1))\gg S_{e+1}\gg k_{n(e+2)}$. This is only the action on the single indicated source summand; it asserts no equation for the action on the entire direct sum.

proof.text: Set a=n(0+1), d=n(e+1), t=n((e+1)+1). The equality d+a=t is distributivity of multiplication. Use tensorHomogeneousKernel_action for these degrees and s=tensorPowSection f 1 ≫ (D.a 0).inv. By the definition of tensorGradedSection, its left side is exactly the action in the statement.

Use tensorIdealSectionMultiply_coefficient_comparison to replace raw ideal multiplication on Z by boundaryCoefficientDegreeIso_e.hom ≫ mulTensorPowSection f F e 1 ≫ boundaryCoefficientDegreeIso_(e+1).inv. Expand tensorHomogeneousKernelMap, use functoriality of pushforward, expand the displayed isomorphism composites and associate composition. The source and target unit maps are invertible by square_zero_ideal_tensor_unit_isIso. The resulting expression is exactly the required composite. The hypotheses and conclusion are unchanged; hrestrict is not needed since the global action is already a sheaf morphism.

theorem tensorGradedCoefficient_action_on_summand {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (hI : j.ker ^ 2 = ⊥)
    (n : ℕ) (T : TensorGradedPresentation j L) (D : TensorBoundaryComparisonData j L n)
    (hD : canonicalTensorBoundaryComparisons j L hI n = D)
    (e : ℕ) (f : 𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ ((tensorPullback j).obj L).tensorPow n)
    (σ : ∀ U : X.Opens, T.C.right.obj.obj (op U) →+*
      Module.End ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op U)) (T.I.val.obj (op U)))
    (μ : T.C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤) →+* End T.I)
    (hlocal : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (b : T.B.right.obj.obj (op U)) (y : T.I.val.obj (op U)),
      @id (T.B.right.obj.obj (op U))
        (T.i.val.app (op U) (σ U (T.p.right.hom.app (op U) b) y)) =
        b * @id (T.B.right.obj.obj (op U)) (T.i.val.app (op U) y))
    (hrestrict : ∀ (U V : X.Opens) (a : V ⟶ U)
      (g : T.C.right.obj.obj (op U)) (y : T.I.val.obj (op U)),
      T.I.val.map a.op (σ U g y) = σ V (T.C.right.obj.map a.op g) (T.I.val.map a.op y))
    (hglobal : ∀ (g : T.C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤)) (U : X.Opens)
      (y : T.I.val.obj (op U)),
      (μ g).val.app (op U) y = σ U (T.C.right.obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op g) y) :
    letI := square_zero_ideal_tensor_unit_isIso j L hI (n * (e + 1))
    letI := square_zero_ideal_tensor_unit_isIso j L hI (n * ((e + 1) + 1))
    T.k (n * (e + 1)) ≫ μ (tensorGradedSection T D 0 (tensorPowSection f 1)) =
      ((pushforward j).mapIso (boundaryCoefficientDegreeIso j L n e).symm ≪≫
      (asIso ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app
        (j.ker.toModules ⊗ L.tensorPow (n * (e + 1))))).symm ≪≫
      boundaryIdealKernelIso j (L.tensorPow (n * (e + 1)))).inv ≫
        (pushforward j).map
          (mulTensorPowSection f ((tensorPullback j).obj
            (j.ker.toModules ⊗ L.tensorPow n)) e 1) ≫
      ((pushforward j).mapIso (boundaryCoefficientDegreeIso j L n (e + 1)).symm ≪≫
      (asIso ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app
        (j.ker.toModules ⊗ L.tensorPow (n * ((e + 1) + 1))))).symm ≪≫
      boundaryIdealKernelIso j (L.tensorPow (n * ((e + 1) + 1)))).hom ≫
        T.k (n * ((e + 1) + 1))
